What is sublime-text-4?

Sublime Text is a proprietary text and code editor known for its speed, a distraction-free "Goto Anything" file/symbol jumper, multiple simultaneous cursors, and deep customization through plugins and key bindings. It can be downloaded and evaluated in full for free with no enforced time limit, but continued regular use is expected to be licensed.

Install sublime-text-4 on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add sublime-text-4

Good to know

  • No special requirements documented.
